top_signals.title: China Plans to Adopt New Policy Rate That May Lead to Easing
top_signals.summary: China’s central bank signaled its overnight reverse repurchase rate will replace the current seven-day rate as the new policy benchmark, in another step that aligns it closer with global peers and has the potential to push down borrowing costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan to restart accepting foreign workers for meal services at some facilities
top_signals.summary: The government aims to adopt the plan at a Cabinet meeting in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
